name: LTX 2.5 Layout to Render — 3D layout to finished shot (two passes + audio)
title: Turn a 3D layout animation into a finished shot
summary: Upload a grey 3D layout animation and one picture of its first frame as it should look; you get the finished shot with the layout's camera move and the placement of every object, in the look of your picture, with sound.
description:
Lightricks' Layout-to-Render IC-LoRA for LTX 2.5: the layout video (a grey clay render or blocky playblast) gives the camera path and where things are; the look still gives the palette, the light and the materials, and becomes the opening frame. The successor of *Turn a rough 3D render photoreal · LTX 2.3 3DReal*, trained by Lightricks on LTX 2.5 itself, with no trigger word.

The look still matters most: make it from the layout's first frame with an image-edit card. The grey frame itself gives a grey result. Describe the finished shot in one or two sentences that match the still, without the words "clay", "3D" or "Unreal".

Two passes, as on Lightricks' workflow: 8 steps at 960×544, then a 2× pass to 1920×1088. Only the start of the clip is used ("Clip length used", 5 s), at its own frame rate; the frame count snaps to 8k+1. Experimental.

promptGuides.label: LTX IC-LoRA guide — Lightricks
promptGuides.tip: The trigger word 3DREAL is added for you: describe the photoreal look you want — materials, lighting, lens, atmosphere — and the sound; the layout and motion come from your render.

promptGuides.label: 3DREAL LoRA (fal) — trigger word and settings
promptGuides.tip: The trigger word 3DREAL is added for you: describe the real materials and light you want.

author: Lightricks (Layout-to-Render IC-LoRA)

exposedParameters.label: Layout video (a grey clay render or blocky playblast from Blender, Unreal…; 24 fps is best)
Look still (the first frame as it should look: make it from the layout's first frame with an image card, never the grey frame itself)
Prompt (one or two sentences describing the finished shot, matching the look still)
exposedParameters.default: A cinematic, photorealistic shot: physically-based materials, natural light and soft shadows, real textures, subtle depth of field and smooth natural motion.

exposedParameters.label: Layout strength (how strictly the layout's camera and placement are followed)
Working size (shorter side of the first pass; the result is twice this)
Clip length used (seconds, max 10 — only the start of your video is processed)
